record.question: According to Keynes's Absolute Income Hypothesis, the consumption function is given by C = a + bY where C is consumption expenditure, Y is income, a is autonomous consumption, and b is the marginal propensity to consume (MPC). Given the following data: Income (Y): 200 crore, 300 crore; Consumption (C): 180 crore, 250 crore. (a) Determine the values of a and b. (b) Calculate the consumption when income rises to 400 crore. (c) Compute saving at this level of income (i.e 400 crore).
